result.summary: Restored the argparse description in `forgel_code/cli.py` to the previous release's exact wording (`Thin console client for Forgel over the engine's machine-readable commands.`) by dropping only the added sentence `Run it without a command to open the interactive session.` Nothing else in the file, the parser, the commands, the fall-through into the interactive session on an empty argv, or the one-shot output/exit-status paths was touched. Added `tests/test_cli_help_description.py`, which pins the released description text in the parser and in `--help` (both in-process and as a real `python -m forgel_code --help` process) and asserts the help output no longer mentions the interactive session; no existing test asserted the removed sentence, so none was weakened or deleted. Verified with `git diff forgel_code/cli.py` (single-line description change), `python -m forgel_code --help` (prints the released description, no interactive sentence), and the full suite `python -m pytest`: 382 passed.
